description: This file defines the FileAppender class and its companion object, which handle appending data from an InputStream to a file, with support for log rolling strategies based on size or time intervals, within the Apache Spark project.

classes.name: FileAppender
classes.description: Handles continuous appending of data from an InputStream to a file, with support for stopping, thread management, and log rolling.

methods.name: awaitTermination
methods.description: Waits for the appending thread to finish.

methods.name: appendStreamToFile
methods.description: Continuously reads from the input stream and writes to the file until stopped or an error occurs.

methods.name: appendToFile
methods.description: Writes a byte array to the output file stream.

methods.name: openFile
methods.description: Opens the file output stream for appending.

methods.name: closeFile
methods.description: Flushes and closes the file output stream.
